scope: Local release verification for login/message-page and category loading optimizations

resolution.cause: Two selection-interaction tests required a redundant body request after selecting an already hydrated card. Valid body-cache reuse correctly avoids that request.
resolution.change: Exercise graph and list selection separately with a fully warm cache and with later message bodies absent from the first page. Assert no download on cache hits, and immediate selection/deselection while a genuine missing-body request is held pending.
resolution.command: npx vitest run frontend/src/test/message-workbench-page.test.tsx -t 'updates card selection immediately' --maxWorkers=1

regression.method: The complete suite was run once. After its two obsolete request assumptions were replaced, all four affected interaction scenarios were rerun. The other 4337 passing cases and application code were unchanged; the complete suite was not repeated after this test-only edit.

checks.result: passed with the updated test cases
